title: Feature record
description: Feature extractor to classifier. Headers, sizes and timing only. No addresses, no payload.

flow_id.description: Salted hash of the 5-tuple. The controller keeps the mapping back to the conntrack entry.

host_id.description: Salted hash of the LAN host. Used for leases and fairness, never as a model feature.

kind.description: initial: emitted once, after the 8th packet. window: emitted for a reclassification check.

ts_ns.description: CLOCK_MONOTONIC time at which the record was emitted.

src_port.description: Port on the initiator side of the flow.

dst_port.description: Port on the responder side of the flow.

pkt_sizes.description: L3 length in bytes of the first 8 packets, IP header included. Positive is LAN to WAN, negative is WAN to LAN.

pkt_gaps_us.description: Microseconds between consecutive packets of pkt_sizes.

window.description: Statistics over the last 1 to 5 one-second conntrack samples. Null when no full sample exists yet.

samples.description: Number of one-second samples the statistics cover.

mean_pkt_size_up.description: bytes_up / pkts_up over the window. 0 when no packets.

mean_pkt_size_down.description: bytes_down / pkts_down over the window. 0 when no packets.

pkt_size_spread.description: Standard deviation of the per-second mean packet size, both directions combined.

rate_cv.description: Regularity of timing: coefficient of variation of the per-second packet count.

burstiness.description: Peak per-second bytes divided by mean per-second bytes. 1 is perfectly steady; 0 when the window is idle.
